chemistry-killer-02.title: Konservasaun masa, proporsaun konstante, reasaun ezotérmika no endotérmika
chemistry-killer-02.topic: Konservasaun masa, proporsaun konstante, reasaun ezotérmika no endotérmika
chemistry-killer-02.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-02.material:
Iha temperatura no presaun konstante, hidrojéniu ($\mathrm{H_2}$) no oksijéniu ($\mathrm{O_2}$) reaje hodi forma bee-ahi ($\mathrm{H_2O}$(g)). Volume total gás ne'ebé mede iha temperatura no presaun hanesan depois mistura gás oin-oin reaje kompletu mak tuir mai (bee-ahi hotu iha estadu gás).
(A) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → total depois reasaun 35 mL
(B) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → total depois reasaun 30 mL
Mistura gás $\mathrm{H_2}$ no $\mathrm{O_2}$ 60 mL reaje kompletu iha temperatura no presaun hanesan, no volume total gás depois reasaun mak 45 mL, no gás ne'ebé hela mak $\mathrm{O_2}$ de'it ($\mathrm{H_2}$ la hela). Oinsá mak liga loos tuir orden volume $\mathrm{H_2}$ molok reasaun no volume $\mathrm{O_2}$ ne'ebé hela depois reasaun?
chemistry-killer-02.thinking.0: Konservasaun masa, proporsaun konstante, reasaun ezotérmika no endotérmika
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.prompt:
Iha temperatura no presaun konstante, hidrojéniu ($\mathrm{H_2}$) no oksijéniu ($\mathrm{O_2}$) reaje hodi forma bee-ahi ($\mathrm{H_2O}$(g)). Volume total gás ne'ebé mede iha temperatura no presaun hanesan depois mistura gás oin-oin reaje kompletu mak tuir mai (bee-ahi hotu iha estadu gás).
(A) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → total depois reasaun 35 mL
(B) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → total depois reasaun 30 mL
Mistura gás $\mathrm{H_2}$ no $\mathrm{O_2}$ 60 mL reaje kompletu iha temperatura no presaun hanesan, no volume total gás depois reasaun mak 45 mL, no gás ne'ebé hela mak $\mathrm{O_2}$ de'it ($\mathrm{H_2}$ la hela). Oinsá mak liga loos tuir orden volume $\mathrm{H_2}$ molok reasaun no volume $\mathrm{O_2}$ ne'ebé hela depois reasaun?
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.explain:
Pasu 1: Verifika rasio volume ho (A), (B). (B): H2 20 mL reaje ho O2 10 mL hodi forma H2O 20 mL, O2 10 mL hela → total 30 mL. (A): H2 30 mL reaje ho O2 15 mL hodi forma H2O 30 mL, O2 5 mL hela → total 35 mL. Nune'e rasio volume reasaun mak $\mathrm{H_2:O_2:H_2O(g)} = 2:1:2$.
Pasu 2: Molok reasaun 60 mL, depois reasaun 45 mL, tan ne'e menus 15 mL. Iha reasaun, kada volume gás 3 sai 2 no menus volume 1, no volume ne'ebé menus = volume $\mathrm{O_2}$ ne'ebé reaje, tan ne'e $\mathrm{O_2}$ ne'ebé reaje = 15 mL.
Pasu 3: Tanba $\mathrm{H_2}$ la hela, H2 reaje hotu: 15×2 = 30 mL. H2O(g) ne'ebé forma = 30 mL. Tanba total depois reasaun 45 mL, $\mathrm{O_2}$ ne'ebé hela = 45 − 30 = 15 mL. $\mathrm{O_2}$ molok reasaun = 15 + 15 = 30 mL, soma 30 + 30 = 60 mL hanesan.
Resposta: 30 mL, 15 mL (b).
chemistry-killer-02.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-02.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
